note: Both sets simply enumerate the five legend labels of Figure 2-11 (Pitch axis, Mass center, Neutral center, Geometric center, Shear center) with the same quotes, and neither extracts the actual plotted quantity (chordwise position in metres versus blade span r/R) or any values. Set A frames the attribute as 'structural property center' under the 'blade planform' caption context, while Set B frames it as 'structural property' with 'chordwise position' as the condition; both are equally defensible readings of the same legend and equally trivial.
